subject: I
fact: I had stopped counting the steps because counting had started to feel like superstition, like I was measuring the distance against the possibility of failure.
source_quote: I had stopped counting the steps somewhere around the third hour of climbing — not because I lost track, but because counting had started to feel like superstition, like I was measuring the distance against the possibility of failure.

subject: I
fact: I had been thinking about the moment of the Overbright, intermittently, for months, not with anticipation exactly — anticipation implies you trust the thing to happen.
source_quote: I had been thinking about this moment, intermittently, for months. Not with anticipation exactly — anticipation implies you trust the thing to happen.

subject: I
fact: I had been carrying the Overbright through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone like a stone in a pocket, something I reached for when the tunnels pressed too close.
source_quote: The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone like a stone in a pocket, something I reached for when the tunnels pressed too close.

subject: I
fact: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.
source_quote: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: The class on material impermanence
fact: There was a class for this — some form of material impermanence — I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.
source_quote: There was a class for this. Some form of material impermanence — I think it was Brother Quellin, or possibly the tall one whose name I never quite caught, the one who always had chalk dust on his robe. The transience of tools. The attachment to implements. Something about a bowl and an empty hand.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze — had peered out.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze, the most improbable relationship any of us had formed in the Underdark, which was saying something given the competition — had peered out.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool had peered out, wide and present and sweeping across the surface world with an attention that made my own response to the Overbright seem, by comparison, measured.
source_quote: He peered. He had not been in sunlight before. None of us were entirely sure what Glabbagool's eyes were, from a structural standpoint, but they were wide and present and sweeping across the surface world with an attention that made my own response to the Overbright seem, by comparison, measured.

subject: I
fact: I watched him watch the sky.
source_quote: I watched him watch the sky.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was doing something with his hands that was probably prayer and probably sincere.
source_quote: Grygum was doing something with his hands that was probably prayer and probably sincere.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was, I suspected, already drafting a journal entry.
source_quote: Daz was, I suspected, already drafting a journal entry.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz's particular analytical gravity was already pulling the decision toward a conclusion before the conversation began.
source_quote: The decision about what to do with the months was largely Daz's call, framed as a group discussion but with Daz's particular analytical gravity already pulling it toward a conclusion before the conversation began.

subject: Daz
fact: The conclusion — Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history — was reasonable.
source_quote: The conclusion — Candlekeep, the Great Library, research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history — was reasonable.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was thinking about Dawnbringer — not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through.
source_quote: Thorin, characteristically, was thinking about Dawnbringer. Not what to do with it; he would never give it up, and the sword would never go quietly. But what it had been through.

subject: Thorin's sword whisperer
fact: Thorin had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about, which meant he believed this person existed and should be found.
source_quote: He had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up, delivered with the particular dwarvish seriousness that Thorin applied to things he actually cared about, which meant he believed this person existed and should be found.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was the only one among us who had accumulated a list of things he wanted to read, and Candlekeep was going to be, for him, something between research and pilgrimage.
source_quote: Grygum had pamphlets on his mind. This was entirely consistent. Grygum was the only one among us who had accumulated a list of things he wanted to read, and Candlekeep was going to be, for him, something between research and pilgrimage.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum would look up the lore of Bahamut. He would pick up pamphlets. He would be genuinely delighted by the availability of pamphlets.
source_quote: He would look up the lore of Bahamut. He would pick up pamphlets. He would be genuinely delighted by the availability of pamphlets.

subject: I
fact: The debate that surfaced was the familiar one: invest it in something that might grow, or spend it on what would keep us alive.
source_quote: Someone raised the question of the gold. We had more of it than we had started with — which was not saying much, given that we had started with nothing — and the debate that surfaced was the familiar one: invest it in something that might grow, or spend it on what would keep us alive.

subject: I
fact: We agreed on the gear.
source_quote: We agreed on the gear.

subject: I
fact: I thought: this is where we were going. We had made it. Now there was everything else.
source_quote: I stood at the entrance to the surface world, squinting at a sky that went farther than anything I had navigated in months, and I thought: this is where we were going. We had made it. Now there was everything else.

subject: I
fact: I noted the category and moved on.
source_quote: I had no opinion on sword whisperers. I noted the category and moved on.

subject: I
fact: I found that admirable in a way I was not going to say out loud.
source_quote: I found that admirable in a way I was not going to say out loud.

subject: I
fact: I noted the response. Filed it.
source_quote: I noted the response. Filed it.

subject: I
fact: I stood and let the light happen to me.
source_quote: I stood and let the light happen to me.

subject: I
fact: I put my cloak in a bag.
source_quote: I put my cloak in a bag.

subject: I
fact: It had not, in fact, worked itself out.
source_quote: It had not, in fact, worked itself out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin stood with his face at an angle that suggested he was calculating the sun's position relative to the year.
source_quote: Thorin stood with his face at an angle that suggested he was calculating the sun's position relative to the year.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz came through last, the way Daz always came through last, already observing before he was fully present, already composing the analysis before his feet had cleared the threshold.
source_quote: Daz came through last, the way Daz always came through last, already observing before he was fully present, already composing the analysis before his feet had cleared the threshold.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum next, blinking with something that looked less like discomfort and more like relief, the earnest half-orc having what appeared to be a genuine spiritual moment with direct sunlight.
source_quote: Grygum next, blinking with something that looked less like discomfort and more like relief, the earnest half-orc having what appeared to be a genuine spiritual moment with direct sunlight.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.

subject: I
fact: We stood in the Overbright for a while, longer than was probably necessary from a tactical standpoint, and nobody suggested moving immediately.
source_quote: We stood in the Overbright for a while, longer than was probably necessary from a tactical standpoint, and nobody suggested moving immediately.

subject: I
fact: We were a group that moved quickly, that had learned to move quickly, that treated stillness as the thing you did when stillness was the only remaining option.
source_quote: We were a group that moved quickly, that had learned to move quickly, that treated stillness as the thing you did when stillness was the only remaining option.

subject: I
fact: The weeks that followed blurred in the way that recovery blurs — not forgetting, exactly, but the edges going soft.
source_quote: The weeks that followed blurred in the way that recovery blurs — not forgetting, exactly, but the edges going soft.

subject: I
fact: The party spread toward its separate concerns the way a held breath spreads into air, each of us expanding slightly into the space the Underdark had compressed out of us.
source_quote: The party spread toward its separate concerns the way a held breath spreads into air, each of us expanding slightly into the space the Underdark had compressed out of us.

subject: I
fact: The logic for adventuring gear was simple enough that even I could lay it out without needing a meeting: we were people who went into danger. Gear reduced the consequences of danger. Business ventures required infrastructure we did not have, stability we had not earned, and a calendar that the demon lord situation was unlikely to respect.
source_quote: The logic for adventuring gear was simple enough that even I could lay it out without needing a meeting: we were people who went into danger. Gear reduced the consequences of danger. subject: I
fact: I stood and let the light happen to me. I put my cloak in a bag. I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.
source_quote: I stood and let the light happen to me. I put my cloak in a bag. I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: I
fact: I watched him watch the sky. Whatever he made of it, I did not have the vocabulary to ask.
source_quote: I watched him watch the sky. Whatever he made of it, I did not have the vocabulary to ask.

subject: I
fact: He took it in the way a child takes in a first ocean, the way the sheer scale of a thing produces a silence that is not quite awe but is adjacent to it.
source_quote: He took it in the way a child takes in a first ocean, the way the sheer scale of a thing produces a silence that is not quite awe but is adjacent to it.
